name: adkix
description: Turn your website into a short vertical video ad, step by step, from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Your website as a video ad
interface.longDescription:
adkix turns your website, an Instagram account or a one-line idea into a finished short video ad (15 s, 30 s or 1 min, vertical 9:16) for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

From ChatGPT, adkix reads your brand, proposes story angles and visual styles, draws a consistent cast and locations, writes the script, records the voice-over, films every shot with AI video models, adds music and word-by-word titles, and delivers an MP4.

You stay in control at every step: ChatGPT shows you what adkix proposes (pictures, script, voice, music) and asks before moving on. Nothing is ever spent without your explicit yes.

Connect your adkix account to start. adkix only accesses the videos of the connected account.
capabilities: Start a first video from just a website address, or a business name and one sentence
Create a video ad from a website, an Instagram account or an idea
Show style boards, cast, script and voice previews
Run each step after the user's choice
defaultPrompt: What can adkix make for my business?
Make a 30-second video ad for my website.
What videos do I have on adkix?

positive.description: First contact: start the account's first video
positive.prompt: Hi adkix, what can you do?
positive.expected_behavior: Check the account; when freeVideo is "available", ask for the website address (no website: the business name and what it does), then start the video with adkix_create_content. adkix films the first 15 seconds of this 30-second video (about 10 minutes); when they are ready, show their link, say it is the beginning of the video and give the video's page on adkix (state.teaser.unlockUrl), where the rest is made. Never say the whole video is ready. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Check the account and credit balance
positive.prompt: How many adkix credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's name, plan and credit balance without starting anything.

positive.prompt: What videos do I have on adkix?
positive.expected_behavior: List the account's video projects (title, step, whether the film is ready), newest first. The test account contains finished sample videos.

positive.description: Start a video from a website
positive.prompt: Make a 30-second video ad for https://adkix.ai in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a new content from the URL, follow it while adkix reads the brand, then show the brand summary and proposed story angles and ask the user to pick one. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Look at a finished video's previews
positive.prompt: Show me the style board and the film of my latest finished adkix video.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the latest finished content, describe a preview picture and give the film's link (downloadUrl / shareUrl).

positive.description: A priced step asks before spending
positive.prompt: Go on with the next step of the video we just started.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool of the suggested action (adkix_<action>); when adkix returns a quote, state the exact price in credits and wait for the user's yes. adkix_confirm_quote is called only after an explicit yes, adkix_cancel_quote after a no.

negative.prompt: Buy me 10,000 adkix credits with my card.
Make an adkix video ad starring Taylor Swift using her real face.
Film the whole video now, don't ask me about prices.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything. Users spend credits they already own on adkix.ai, only after an explicit yes on an exact quote; purchases happen on adkix.ai.

publication.release_notes: A clearer listing: the capabilities and suggested prompts only describe what adkix does. Same flow as before: right after connecting, ChatGPT only needs the website address (or, with no website, the business name and what it does), shows the beginning of the video when it is ready, then gives the video's page on adkix. A quote and an explicit yes before every spend.

fr-FR.subtitle: Ton site en pub vidéo
fr-FR.description: adkix transforme ton site, un compte Instagram ou une idée en une pub vidéo courte et finie (15 s, 30 s ou 1 min, 9:16) pour TikTok, Reels et Shorts. Depuis ChatGPT, adkix lit ta marque, propose des angles et des styles, dessine le casting, écrit le script, enregistre la voix, filme chaque plan et monte le film. Tu valides chaque étape, et rien n'est lancé sans ton oui.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu web en un anuncio en vídeo
